role_title: Front-End Web Developer (Kenya & Remote Market Ready)
context: Kenya Refugee Inclusion & Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Pathway
sdg_alignment: SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth

credential_status_notes.missing_documents_displacement: Certificates or transcripts lost during displacement (e.g., from Somalia, South Sudan, DRC, Ethiopia, or Burundi). Evaluated via practical front-end evidence and RPL principles without score penalty.
credential_status_notes.unverified_foreign_credential: Foreign diploma or technical certificate held but awaiting formal KNQA (Kenya National Qualifications Authority) equation/recognition. Treated as background context while validating live coding artifacts.
credential_status_notes.camp_or_urban_self_taught: Skills acquired through Kakuma, Dadaab, Kalobeyei, or urban Nairobi digital hubs and self-study without formal degrees. Evaluated directly on code quality and live builds.
credential_status_notes.partial_records: Partial academic transcripts or bootcamp records available; paired with targeted practical rubric checks.

kenya_onboarding_notes.Refugee ID / Alien Card: Under the Kenya Refugees Act, 2021, refugees with valid Refugee ID cards can pursue formal employment, business permits, and digital/remote contracting.
kenya_onboarding_notes.Pending Documentation: Candidates awaiting updated Refugee ID or work permit endorsement can begin remote freelancing, open-source portfolio building, or stipended fellowship tracks while legal/admin steps complete.

competencies.name: Semantic HTML & Accessibility
evidence_examples: Accessible form labels, alt attributes, and mobile-friendly structure
competencies.bridging_action: Build a 2-page accessible community service portal form using semantic HTML5 tags and test keyboard navigation.

competencies.name: Responsive CSS, Flexbox/Grid & Low-Bandwidth UI
evidence_examples: Mobile-first layouts using Flexbox or CSS Grid (360px mobile to 1280px desktop)
Lightweight assets and clean typography suitable for mobile data users in Kenya
competencies.bridging_action: Build a mobile-first responsive product/service directory page tested on 360px and 1280px viewports with lightweight CSS.

competencies.name: JavaScript Interactivity, State & API/Data Handling
evidence_examples: DOM manipulation, search/filter logic, and client-side form validation
Fetching JSON data with clean loading and offline/error states
competencies.bridging_action: Build an interactive Kenyan SME or community resource finder with live search, category filtering, localStorage, and API error handling.

competencies.name: Git/GitHub Workflow & Live Portfolio Delivery
evidence_examples: Structured GitHub repository with clear README and setup steps
Deployed live demo (GitHub Pages/Netlify/Vercel) or reproducible local build
competencies.bridging_action: Publish 2 front-end projects on GitHub with clear README documentation, screenshots, and a live hosted link.
